title: Port the EPP Markdown and compliance renderer contract
goal: Preserve the old EPP manual-browser Markdown, compliance, CFR, and regulatory rendering behavior in the standalone app.
acceptance_criteria: Reader output strips internal sections while keeping canonical Markdown unchanged
Headings, anchors, lists, code blocks, tables, assembly blocks, regulatory segments, placeholders, and inline CFR links render correctly
Compliance graph links, source metadata, CFR pages, Appendix Z pages, and static regulatory lockout are represented
Desktop screenshot smoke covers representative policy, Appendix Z, CFR, and placeholder-heavy documents
non_goals: Editing or rewriting regulatory source documents
Full redesign of every artifact renderer
validation: Compare rendered output against the old generated browser for representative documents
notes: Use the old generator as behavior evidence. Prefer staged React/service slices over copying generated HTML. Service-backed document reads are expected to arrive through SG-0013.
